segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Jordan. I pulled up the quote we discussed: 42 seats for the operations team, annual term starting October 1, and the implementation package for the first 60 days.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That lines up. The only thing I want to confirm is the seat split. We need 34 standard users and 8 approvers, not 42 all at the same level.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, good catch. I had that in my notes, but the draft quote showed a single line item. I can revise it to show 34 standard at $68 per user per month and 8 approver seats at $29.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And total comes out to what annually with the implementation fee?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: With the seat mix corrected, software is $30,960 for the year. Implementation is a one-time $4,500, so total first-year contract value is $35,460 before taxes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. Procurement will ask about payment terms. We usually do net 45, but your order form said net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can do net 45. I’ll route that through deal desk today and update the billing terms on the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For go-live, we’re targeting November 18. Is that realistic if we sign by next Friday, September 20?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s realistic. If signature is in by September 20, kickoff would be the week of September 23, configuration in October, and user training the first week of November.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Please send the updated quote and order form, and I’ll get it to our finance manager this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the revised documents within the hour, with the corrected seat mix, net 45 terms, and October 1 start date.
